items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I was sitting in my, Paula the other day playing

ctx.x: Well do you, uh, play the melody straight on the last chorus or do you vary the little?

Oh you vary, yeah, you make variations in there. But, uh, I, I always like to stick to the melody so everybody knows what you're playing, Dick. I was sitting in my, Paula the other day playing, who you think walks in there? Yeah. He says, look at all this talent going to work. It's Butch Massico. He's, uh, you know Butch, the drummer?
Yeah, I've seen him. He plays, he works for this Orkin people.
